"""Compare current endpoints with retained quieter V156 on identical observations."""

from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V158-regional-dc-v1')
previous=Path(read(root/'plan-v1.json')['previous'])
current=read(root/'scores-v1.json');prior=read(previous/'scores-v1.json')
new_cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations'];old_cases=read(previous/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
assert len(new_cases)==len(old_cases)==822
assert all(a['id']==b['id'] and a['arrays']==b['arrays'] and a['parent']==b['parent'] for a,b in zip(new_cases,old_cases,strict=True))
now={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in current['rows']}
old={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in prior['rows']}
for c in new_cases:
    a,b=now[c['id'],'parent'],old[c['id'],'parent']
    assert a==b
groups=[];summary=[]
for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']:
    method=f'dc-regret-{endpoint}-step1000';baseline=f'local-control-{endpoint}-step1000'
    for condition in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']:
        selected=[c for c in new_cases if c['kind']=='mixed-quiet' and c['noise']['name']==condition]
        assert len(selected)==16
        for field in ['quiet_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16','crop_DC_RMS_DN16']:
            pairs=[{'id':c['id'],'candidate':now[c['id'],method][field],'baseline':old[c['id'],baseline][field],
                    'difference':now[c['id'],method][field]-old[c['id'],baseline][field]} for c in selected]
            differences=[p['difference'] for p in pairs]
            groups.append({'method':method,'retained_V156_method':baseline,'condition':condition,'field':field,
                'cases':16,'pairs':pairs,'better':sum(v<0 for v in differences),'worse':sum(v>0 for v in differences),
                'equal':sum(v==0 for v in differences),'maximum_increase':max(differences),'minimum_difference':min(differences)})
    for kind,condition,cohort,field in [('mesh',True,None,'template_gain'),
        ('mixed-quiet','iso6400-prior',None,'quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),
        ('mixed-quiet','iso12800-prior',None,'quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),
        ('flat','iso6400-prior','fresh-flat512','full_error_RMS_DN16'),
        ('flat','iso12800-prior','fresh-flat512','block32_RMS_DN16')]:
        key=(kind,condition,cohort)
        a=next(v[field] for v in current['summary'] if (v['kind'],v['condition'],v['cohort'])==key and v['method']==method)
        b=next(v[field] for v in prior['summary'] if (v['kind'],v['condition'],v['cohort'])==key and v['method']==baseline)
        summary.append({'method':method,'retained_V156_method':baseline,'kind':kind,'condition':condition,'cohort':cohort,
            'field':field,'candidate':a,'baseline':b,'percent_change':100*(a/b-1)})
dest=root/'retained-V156-comparison-v1.json';assert not dest.exists()
save(dest,{'status':'completed-retained-V156-comparison','scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    'V157_scores_containing_matched_V156':ref(previous/'scores-v1.json'),'same822_input_parent_bindings':True,
    'same_parent_metric_rows':True,'groups':groups,'summary':summary,'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'V156 quieter relative head retained from exact V157 control. Same inputs/parents and parent metrics verified. Comparison also changes architecture/base supervision versus V156,so it does not isolate regional-DC loss causality. Native V156 columns reuse these arrays;four CFA placements are related observations,not independent scenes.'})
for item in summary:print(item)
